items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: He played with Silverleaf. He played with the Silverleaf Band. Yeah, he played with us.

ctx.x: Well, when did Henry Russ mention that? He said he played in the Silvertone Band. He must have maybe, maybe he's mixed up on that.
He probably got mixed up on that. He played with Silverleaf. He played with the Silverleaf Band. Yeah, he played with us.
And what about Sam Dutry Sr.?
